scope: user (project-local loads only when the project .codex/ layer is trusted)

registration.toml_variant:
[[hooks.PreToolUse]]
matcher = "^Bash$"

[[hooks.PreToolUse.hooks]]
type = "command"
command = '/usr/bin/python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.codex/hooks/pre_tool_use_policy.py"'
timeout = 30
statusMessage = "Checking Bash command"
registration.locations_quote: In practice, the four most useful locations are: ~/.codex/hooks.json, ~/.codex/config.toml, <repo>/.codex/hooks.json, <repo>/.codex/config.toml

stdin.snippet: Fields in addition to Common input fields: | `turn_id` | `string` | Codex-specific extension. Active Codex turn id | `tool_name` | `string` | Canonical hook tool name, such as `Bash`, `apply_patch`, or an MCP name like `mcp__fs__read` | `tool_use_id` | `string` | Tool-call id for this invocation | `tool_input` | `JSON value` | Tool-specific input. `Bash` and `apply_patch` use `tool_input.command`. MCP and other local function tools send their arguments.

deny.quote: To deny a supported tool call, return this hook-specific shape: {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Destructive command blocked by hook."}} ... You can also use exit code `2` and write the blocking reason to `stderr`.

gaps: No full example stdin JSON on page, only field table (command location stated in table)
Doc does not say explicitly that stderr text is model-visible
Page warns PreToolUse callback error, timeout, or malformed response can fail without blocking
